pre_registration_note: Measurement-only scorecard for the LIVE P2 copy-trade sleeve as currently specified by docs/specs/p2_spec.json. Acceptance criteria, cohort split, round-trip definition, benchmark and trial-count method were fixed here BEFORE scripts/research/p2_scorecard.py was run on the real trade log. It places no orders and changes no live parameter.
universe: US-listed equities bought by copying US-politician BUY disclosures (benchmark_sleeve rows excluded)
entry_rule: as live (p2_spec.json): politician BUY disclosure + technical confirmation; conviction-bucket sizing
exit_rule: as live (p2_spec.json): stop-loss / trailing stop / take-profit / time exit / mirrored politician SELL
signal_bar: t (disclosure observed by close of day t)
sizing: as live; scorecard returns are per-lot (realized P&L / cost basis), so sizing does not enter alpha
friction_note: Live round trips are scored on REALIZED broker P&L (fills already include slippage; Alpaca commission = 0). No extra friction is added to trades, and the SPY comparator is frictionless — both choices are conservative for alpha.
benchmark: beta-matched SPY over the identical holding window: alpha = lot_return - beta * SPY_return(entry_date close -> exit_date close)

beta_policy.reason: P2 book equity (journal account snapshots) is intraday-timestamped and blended with the benchmark ETF sleeve and cash, so its beta is not the beta of a single fully-invested copy-trade lot. beta=1 (market-adjusted return) is the gate; the book-equity beta is reported as a diagnostic and used as a sensitivity only when reliable (r_squared >= 0.3 and 0 < beta < 2).

round_trip_definition: A lot = all BUY rows sharing one broker order_id (fallback: symbol+date). Partial exits are summed slice-by-slice. A lot is a CLOSED round trip only when every slice is closed with a realized pnl; a lot with an open remainder is reported separately and excluded from N. Slices closed without a recorded pnl (reconciler orphans) make the lot UNPRICED and excluded — never imputed. benchmark_sleeve rows and SELL exit markers are not lots.

cohorts.pre: entry date <= 2026-07-04 (old Capitol-Trades pipeline; informational only)
cohorts.post: entry date > 2026-07-04 (House-FD pipeline; the ONLY cohort that is gated)

trial_count_method: Honest N = distinct P2 rule configurations evaluated in committed research artifacts (count of 'overall' result blocks in data/p2_congress_copy_backtest.json, data/p2_congress_technical_confirmation_backtest.json, data/p2_cluster_buy_backtest.json) + size of the max_disclosure_age grid in data/p2_disclosure_lag_study.json + 2 live pipeline versions. DSR benchmark = expected max per-trade Sharpe of N zero-skill trials (False Strategy Theorem, null variance 1/(N_obs-1)).

acceptance.profit_factor_basis: realized $ P&L per closed round trip
acceptance.status_rule: post-cohort N < min_n => INSUFFICIENT_N (values shown, no verdict). Otherwise PASS only if alpha t >= 2.0 AND PF >= 1.3 AND DSR >= 0.95, else FAIL.
